summary.name: FabDream
summary.one_liner: Portfolio and services site of Geneva-based creative director Fabio Comparelli (aka fabdream), offering AI-made brand films, web development, AI automation and AI strategy consulting.
use_cases: Building a custom website or visual identity
Automating repetitive business workflows with AI agents
Getting advice on where AI fits in a business
Learning AI filmmaking process through tutorials
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Fabio Comparelli's work as a Geneva-based creative director and AI developer. Services listed are brand films made with AI, creative development from visual identity to working website, AI workflows and agents for automation, and AI strategy and advisory. It showcases a commissioned 49-second brand film for Pedia.digital made end-to-end with AI, and a short film produced in 48 hours using AI agents that was selected in the top 8 worldwide at the Arca Gidan International Competition 2026. It also mentions tutorials on the production process and Fabdream Studio, a creative hub with tools for AI storytelling. Contact is via a form.
notable: End-to-end AI film production (storyboard, image generation, transitions, voiceover)
Short film made in 48 hours using AI agents, top 8 worldwide at Arca Gidan 2026
Fabdream Studio creative hub with AI storytelling tools
caveats: Pricing for services is not stated on the page
Services are commissioned work, not a self-serve tool
